skill.description: Server name: phantom-secrets Repository: https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom-secrets Category: Security Language: Rust License: MIT Install: \`npx phantom-secrets init\` Description Local proxy + MCP server that swaps real secrets for opaque \`phm_\` tokens before they reach the LLM. Real secrets stay in the OS keychain (macOS Keychain / Linux Secret Service / Windows Credential Manager); agents only ever see the tokens. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and Codex. 25 tools include: - Vau
